title: あきらめ知らずの雄風たちよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio suffers another fracture. Her doctor determines that she won't recover in time to run with Yamanin Zephyr in the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, her injuries have weakened her legs to the extent that even after recovering, she may never again run as well as she used to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Teio won't give up. Seeing that Zephyr is pushing forwards inspires her to do the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells Zephyr to wait a little longer for her—although she won't be able to run in the autumn Tenno Sho, she will make a comeback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As long as they both keep running, there's no limit to the number of promises they can make to each other.
